whenToUse: Chat and assistant transcripts in a bounded panel that open on the newest turn and offer a jump back to it
Streaming replies that follow the bottom until the reader scrolls up, with sent questions lifted near the top
Saved threads that reopen at a chosen turn, load older history above the reader or step between questions

whenNotToUse.when: The layout of a single turn, its avatar, sender name and timestamp around the body
A sidebar, settings list or panel that overflows but never grows at the bottom
A finished assistant screen with composer, thread list, citations and docked panels

agentNotes: The parts and hooks throw outside `MessageScrollerProvider`, so a header or footer control that calls a hook needs the provider above it too
`MessageScroller` fills its parent through `size-full`, so bound the parent height or the page scrolls instead of the transcript
Render `MessageScrollerButton` as a sibling of `MessageScrollerViewport`; placed inside it, the control scrolls away with the rows
